summary: Walks the animation-node linked list anchored at this+0x204, and for each node's track array decrements track values that reference a given animation data entry (a2) by that entry's step value, gated by the entry index being in bounds (a3 <= a2+164), the entry type being non-terminal (a2-derived value at +72 > 1), and the track value being at or above the step threshold (a2-derived value at +80).

local_names.a2: animation data entry reference (base for the entry array lookup and track match)
local_names.a3: entry index used to compute the entry pointer
local_names.i: current animation node; i[4] is the next-node link and i[70]/i[71] describe its track array
local_names.v5: iterator over track slots (stride 16, starting at i[71]+52)

operations.description: If a2 is null, skip the entire function (no animation data reference).
If a3 is greater than the entry count at *(a2+164), skip (entry index out of bounds).
v3 = *(a2+168) + 148 * a3 — compute the entry pointer for entry a3.
If *(v3+72) is <= 1, skip the traversal (entry type is terminal/single-frame).
Iterate the linked list of animation nodes from this[129] (this+0x204), following the next-node pointer i[4] until null.
If i[70] is zero, the node has no tracks to process — skip to the next node.
Iterate the node's track slots: v5 starts at i[71]+52 and advances by 16 per slot, for i[70] iterations.
If *(v5-12) != a2, the track does not reference this animation data entry — skip the decrement.
v7 = *v5; if *v5 is >= the step value *(v3+80), v7 is reduced by that step value.
Store the adjusted value back: *v5 = v7 — decrement the track value by the entry's step value.
Function returns void; traversal completes without a value.
